raw_segments.text: Athena, mine is the right to add the final vote, and I award it to Oreste's cause.
For me no mother bore within her womb, and save for wedlock evermore eschewed, I vouch
myself the champion of the man, not of the woman, yea, with all my soul, in heart as
Thus will I not too heinously regard a woman's death who did her husband's sleigh, the guardian
of her home, and if the vote's equal do fall, Oreste's shall prevail.
Ye of the judges who are named thereto, swiftly shake forth the lots from either urn.
